hypothesis.statement: Streamed generation follows the same target-policy distribution as resident generation.
hypothesis.criterion: Written before the Ticket 06 acceptance run (after a disclosed CPU pilot; see docs/l2l/06_generator.md). Case generation_equivalence: on the same device with the same weights and prompts, the streamed generator (plain layer call and L2L weight streaming, KV cache on the compute device and on the CPU) gives greedy token sequences and per-step next-token logits equal to transformers generate()'s, and next-token probabilities along hf-sampled trajectories (teacher-forced) equal to hf's sampling distribution (tolerance 0); cached decoding agrees with the resident full-prefix forward within the derived rounding bound (generation_equivalence in tolerances.yaml), and greedy tokens agree wherever the top-1 / top-2 margin exceeds twice that bound. Grid: both fixture shapes x eager/sdpa x fp32/bf16, LoRA on the first and last layers, two sets of left-padded prompts of different lengths, plus an EOS-boosted model (rows ending in EOS with a padded tail are required) and a real-vocabulary model with non-thinking Qwen3 chat prompts. Execution requirements: one weight load per layer per generated token, the KV cache equals its analytic size, |logits| <= 16 in every reference. NOT_SUPPORTED if any comparison fails.
